C69.content_en:
Ways to check your own Google Business info — and how the main tools compare

A shop owner wants to confirm whether the details shown for their shop on Google Maps are right. Enter "shop name and area" on one line and this tool tabulates the name, category, rating, review count, address, phone and photo count, plus opening hours by weekday.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.0054 per call (measured), roughly 185 per $1One shop's name, category, rating, review count, address, phone, photo count and opening hours in tables. Save as CSV
Google Business Profile dashboardSee the official site for pricingLets you edit the profile of a shop you manage (per Google's page)
Google Maps search (by hand)FreeYou read what you see; lining up other shops is manual
Semrush LocalSee the official site for pricingA local-SEO tool (see the official site for features)

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • A profile in a table from one line. "一蘭 新宿中央東口店" showed a 4.3 rating, 7,891 reviews and 11,947 photos (measured).
  • Opening hours by weekday. A second table lists Monday through Sunday.
  • About $0.0054 per call. Roughly 185 per $1, so you can check nearby shops in a row.
  • Returned in Japanese. Category and address came back in Japanese (measured).
  • Save as CSV. A draft for a comparison sheet with other shops.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want to edit the profile → this tool only looks. Editing is done in the Google Business Profile dashboard.
  • You are not sure it found the right shop → we tested only one shop, but if the name and area do not match, a different shop may come up. Check the name in the first row.
  • You want the text of customer reviews → the table has only the number of reviews.
  • Blank opening hours → a blank weekday means either a day off or no data. This tool cannot tell which.

This tool does one thing: show one shop's Google Business info (name, category, rating, review count, address, phone, photo count and opening hours).

FAQ

How do I write the shop name and area?

Join them with a space on one line, like "一蘭 新宿中央東口店".

What does "00:00–24:00" in the hours mean?

Open 24 hours. Every weekday was like that for the shop we tried.

How many shops did you test?

One (一蘭 新宿中央東口店). We have not checked other shops or shops with little data.

Can I look up other shops?

The tool is built to look up whichever shop you enter. We tested only one, so check the name in the first row if a different shop comes up.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?

C71.content_en:
Ways to check nearby inns' prices — and how the main tools compare

An inn owner wants to know what nearby inns are charging for the coming Saturday. Enter an area and this tool tabulates hotel name, price and rating for one night, two adults, checking in next Saturday.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.004 per call (measured), roughly 250 per $1About 20 hotels in the area with name, price and rating in a table. Save as CSV
Google Travel (Hotels)See the official siteA screen where you set dates and guests and see hotel prices
Rakuten Travel / Jalan (by hand)See the official sitesYou set dates and check inn by inn; lining them up is manual
Booking.com (by hand)See the official siteYou set dates and check inn by inn; lining them up is manual

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • Nearby inns lined up in one call. "京都" returned 20 rows in about 5 seconds (measured).
  • Price and rating side by side. The rating and the number of reviews appear too.
  • About $0.004 per call. Roughly 250 per $1, so you can refresh every Saturday.
  • The date is fixed to "next Saturday, one night, two adults". You do not have to pick dates.
  • Save as CSV. Use it for a weekly record.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want weekday or holiday prices → the date is fixed to one night from next Saturday.
  • Blank prices → when the API returns a price of 0, the cell is left blank. It probably means no price was available, not a free room (reason unconfirmed). The number of blanks varies by area and date (measured: 2 of 20 for "京都", 12 of 20 for "東京 ホテル", and 2 of 18 for the same search on another date).
  • You want prices by room type → the table has one price per inn.
  • You want your own inn's rank → the table shows no rank.

This tool does one thing: show the price and rating of inns in an area for one night from next Saturday.

FAQ

What is the price for?

One night for two adults, checking in next Saturday and out on Sunday. The unit is yen.

Why is a price blank?

The API returned 0 for that hotel, and this tool shows 0 as blank. It probably means no price was available (for example sold out), but we have not confirmed the reason.

How do I write the area?

A place name like "京都" or "浅草". Adding a word, as in "東京 ホテル", also works.

Can I change the date?

Not in this tool. It is fixed to next Saturday.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?
